manifesto.title: Mendly Manifesto
manifesto.subtitle: Why we built this.
manifesto.section1Body1: For 50 years, launching a startup has followed the same implicit rule: find cofounders, raise money, hire a team. Without it, your idea dies.
manifesto.section1Body2: That rule did damage. Thousands of founders with brilliant ideas gave up — not from lack of talent, but lack of hands.
manifesto.section2Title: AI changes the equation. Mendly embodies it.
manifesto.section2Body1: AI doesn't do everything for you. It does something better: it gives you what you've been missing from day one. Someone who pushes back. Not an assistant that nods along.
manifesto.section2Body2: Mendly carries every angle of a leadership team — finance, growth, engineering, product — in a single voice. It remembers your project day after day, exposes its own contradictions, and decides. When a question demands it, it convenes specialists who debate it without you.
manifesto.section3Body1: But founders who get challenged in time will replace those who surround themselves with yes.
manifesto.section3Body2: This isn't a threat or a promise. It's a description of the present.
manifesto.section4Body1: We build for solo founders tired of being limited by their isolation. For those with a clear vision but nobody to stress-test it. For those who want to move fast without moving blind.
manifesto.section4Body2: We don't build for people who want AI to type for them. We build for people who want to hear when they're wrong — before it costs them.

security.title: Our security pledge
security.subtitle: Your ideas are yours. Forever.
security.introBody: The moment you trust Mendly with your project, you trust us. We take that seriously. Here's exactly how we protect what you share with us.
security.p1Title: 1. Encrypted in transit and at rest
security.p1Body: Your data travels encrypted (TLS) and is stored encrypted (AES-256) by our database host. These are our providers' standard mechanisms, not a home-made scheme we ask you to take on faith.
security.p2Body: Your database is hosted by Supabase and the site by Vercel. To answer you, the content of your messages is sent to Google's Gemini model. Several of these providers are based in the United States: those transfers are covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses. The details are in our privacy policy.
security.p3Body: You can delete your account and all your data from your settings. To get a copy of your data, write to us: we send it within the timeframe set by the GDPR.
security.p4Title: 4. We NEVER train on your data
security.p4Body: Your ideas, documents and conversations with Mendly — nothing is used to train models. Ever. This commitment is written into our Terms of Service.
security.p5Body: We don't sell, rent, or share your data with anyone. Period.
security.p6Body: Mendly has not yet undergone an independent security audit. We will say so here the day it has. Meanwhile: database access limited to the people who run the service, dependencies kept up to date, strict security headers across the site.
security.vulnBody: Email us at mendlyai01@gmail.com. We reply within 48 hours and keep you posted until it is fixed.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.s1Body: You have 14 days from the date of your first payment to request a full refund, in accordance with European consumer law (right of withdrawal). No justification required.
refund.s2Body: Send an email to mendlyai01@gmail.com with the subject line "Refund request". Please include the email address linked to your account. We will process your refund within 7 business days.
refund.s3Body: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days of approval. Depending on your bank, it may take an additional 3–5 business days to appear on your statement.
refund.s4Body: The 14-day guarantee applies from the first payment only. Subsequent monthly or annual renewals are not eligible for refund unless required by applicable law. Refunds are not issued in cases of account suspension for violation of our Terms of Service.
refund.s5Body: You can cancel your subscription at any time via the Customer Portal (accessible from your account settings). Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period — you retain full access until then.
refund.s6Body: For any refund-related question, contact us at mendlyai01@gmail.com. We respond within 24 hours.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s1Body: Cookies are small files stored on your device by your browser. They allow a website to remember information about your visit.
cookies.s2Body: Mendly uses only essential cookies necessary for the site to function: authentication cookies (Supabase) to maintain your login session, and a locale cookie to remember your language preference (EN/FR). We do not use marketing, advertising, or analytics tracking cookies.
cookies.s3Body: We do not embed third-party advertising or social media scripts that would set cookies on your device.
cookies.s4Body: You can disable cookies in your browser settings. Note that disabling essential cookies will prevent you from logging in to your Mendly account.
cookies.s5Body: We may update this policy. If we introduce non-essential cookies in the future, we will update this page and inform registered users by email.
cookies.s6Body: For any question about our cookie usage: mendlyai01@gmail.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: Mendly (hereinafter “Mendly”, “we”) is a SaaS service for solo founders. The data controller is Glodi Bandzouzi, reachable at: mendlyai01@gmail.com.
privacy.s2Body: For browsing: no data is collected by any third-party tracker. Mendly uses no Google Analytics, no advertising pixel, no external measurement tool. For the service: your email and hashed password, the content of your projects and conversations with Mendly, your preferences, and your billing information — handled directly by Stripe, never stored by us. We also record internal usage events (feature used, timestamp), only while you are signed in and only in our own database.
privacy.s3Body: Keep you informed about launch (waitlist). Improve our product (analytics). Provide you with the Mendly service (customer account). Comply with our legal obligations.
privacy.s4Title: 4. How long we keep your data
privacy.s4Body: Account data: retained while your account is active + 30 days after deletion. Free plan conversation history: 30 days. Paid plan conversation history: unlimited. Analytics data: 12 months maximum.
privacy.s5Body: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access your personal data, rectify it, erase it (“right to be forgotten”), obtain an exportable copy, restrict its processing, object to that processing, and withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise these rights: mendlyai01@gmail.com. Response within 30 days. You can also delete your account and all of your data directly from your settings. If you believe your rights are not being respected, you may lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).
privacy.s6Body: We rely on the following sub-processors: Vercel (hosting), Supabase (database and authentication), Stripe (payments), Brevo (email), Resend (authentication email) and Google (AI models — Gemini). Several of them are established in the United States: your data may therefore be transferred outside the European Union. These transfers are covered by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses and, for providers that adhere to it, by the EU—US Data Privacy Framework. We neither sell nor rent your data to anyone.
privacy.s7Body: All data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. See our security pledge for more details.
privacy.s8Body: We only use essential cookies required for the site's operation. See our cookie policy.
privacy.s9Body: We may update this policy. Significant changes will be notified by email to subscribed users.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: Mendly is a SaaS platform for independent founders. It provides access to an AI-powered board of directors: it carries several angles of decision-making — finance, growth, engineering, product, strategy, data, execution, communication — and addresses the user as a single voice. Each project also has a meeting room, in which a team of specialists assigned to that project can be convened to debate a question, as well as autonomous working sessions triggered without user intervention. The number of projects, the cadence of autonomous sessions and access to the meeting room depend on the subscribed plan.
terms.s2Body: By using this site or creating an account, you accept these terms. If you don't agree, don't use the service.
terms.s3Body: Creating an account is free. The Free plan includes 1 project, 3 agents, and 10 messages/day. Paid plans — Starter (€19/month) and Pro (€49/month) — unlock the full platform. Annual billing offers a 20% discount. Payment is handled by Stripe and charged automatically at the start of each billing period.
terms.s4Body: Subscriptions are monthly or annual with no long-term commitment. You can cancel at any time via the Customer Portal in your account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. A 14-day refund guarantee applies from the first payment — see our refund policy.
terms.s5Body: When using Mendly, you agree to: not use it for illegal purposes, not attempt to circumvent technical limitations, not generate harmful, hateful, illegal, or misleading content, respect the intellectual property of others.
terms.s6Body: Your ideas are yours. Any content you provide to Mendly remains your property. You grant us a limited license to process this content solely to provide you with the service. The Mendly code, design, brand, and service elements are our property.
terms.s7Body: We never train on your data. We don't share your data with third parties. See our privacy policy for full details.
terms.s8Body: Mendly is provided "as is". Advice generated by AI agents is decision support, not professional advice (legal, medical, financial, etc.). You remain responsible for your strategic and operational decisions. Mendly guarantees no specific business outcomes.
terms.s9Body: Mendly operates on a best-effort basis. No specific uptime guarantee is made. Planned or unplanned maintenance may result in temporary service unavailability.
terms.s10Body: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access in case of serious violation of these terms. You can delete your account at any time from your settings.
terms.s11Body: These terms are governed by French law. Any disputes shall be submitted to the competent courts of France, unless mandatory legal provisions provide otherwise. For any question about the terms: mendlyai01@gmail.com

help.title: Help centre
help.sub: The questions people actually ask. If yours isn't here, write to us — we answer ourselves.
help.a1: A board of directors for a solo founder. You bring it a decision, it challenges you angle by angle — finance, growth, engineering, product — then it makes a call. It is not a team of several assistants: it is one entity carrying all those angles, which exposes its own contradictions rather than smoothing them over.
help.q2: How is it different from ChatGPT?
help.a2: ChatGPT is built to help you, so it agrees with you. Mendly is built to tell you when you are wrong. It knows your project, remembers your past decisions and brings them back by name. And it keeps working when you are away.
help.a3: The team assigned to your project meets without you triggering anything, debates a topic drawn from the real state of your project, and leaves the write-up in the meeting room. It only meets when something new has actually happened — no session just to fill the calendar.
help.q4: Are my conversations used to train a model?
help.a4: No. Your data is neither sold, rented, nor used to train any model. It is processed by Google Gemini for as long as it takes to generate a reply, then stored in our database so that Mendly remembers your project.
help.a5: No. It stays free, with no time limit. It gives you one project, one meeting-room debate, one autonomous session every fourteen days, and full project memory.
help.q6: Can I cancel at any time?
help.a6: Yes, from your settings, with no justification and no fee. The subscription stays active until the end of the period you already paid for, then your account returns to the free plan. Nothing is deleted.
help.q7: What happens if I delete my account?
help.a7: Your projects, conversations, memory and actions are deleted. This is irreversible, and we keep no copy beyond thirty days of technical backups. Deletion happens from your settings, without going through us.
help.q8: How do I get a copy of my data?
help.a8: Write to mendlyai01@gmail.com: we will send you all of your data in a readable format within thirty days, as required by the GDPR. A downloadable export from your settings is in the works.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How is Mendly different from ChatGPT?
faq.a1: A general assistant is trained to satisfy you: it validates your idea, then gives you five steps to pull it off. Mendly starts by asking what you are basing this on. When two of its angles disagree, it says so instead of picking the smoothest answer. Then it decides.
faq.a2: A place separate from the daily conversation. Mendly convenes the specialists assigned to your project — finance, growth, engineering depending on the case — and they genuinely argue over your question before a verdict is reached. Mendly takes you there on its own when a question deserves it.
faq.q3: Does Mendly really work when I am away?
faq.a3: Yes. When an action on your project stays stalled, the team opens a session on its own and leaves you the debrief. You trigger nothing, you read it when you wake up. The cadence depends on your plan.
faq.q4: How many projects can I create?
faq.a4: One on Free, three on Starter, ten on Pro. A project keeps its own memory: decisions, risks, assumptions, milestones. It is not one more chat thread.
faq.q5: What happens to what I write?
faq.a5: Your projects and conversations are never used to train any model. To answer you, their content goes through providers, some based in the United States, under standard contractual clauses — everything is detailed in the privacy policy. Delete a project and its memory goes with it.
faq.q6: Can I stop whenever I want?
faq.a6: Yes, in one click from your settings, without writing to anyone. The plan stays active until the end of the period you already paid for.

closing.title: The only counsel that dares to tell you you are wrong.
closing.sub: Start for free. You will find out quickly whether it is right.

contradiction.question: Should I launch the winter collection this month?
contradiction.tension: Your collection holds up. Your channel does not.
contradiction.body: You have sold 34 pieces since June, 21 of them on a single market day. That is not a curve, it is an event.
contradiction.verdict: Release three pieces this week to measure. You will know before 15 November whether your channel exists.

room.title: Meeting room
room.question: Release the whole collection, or three test pieces?

lines.text: Twelve pieces tie up €4,200 of stock before a single euro comes in.
Three pieces will not make an event. No event, no traffic.
The collection loses its point if you cut it up. It is a season, not a catalogue.

room.verdict: Three pieces, announced as the first chapter of a season.

log.text: Signal — an action has been stalled for eleven days.
The debate opens on the acquisition channel.
Verdict reached. The session is waiting for you.

turns.text: Tell me about your project. What you sell, to whom, and since when.
Handmade ceramics, one collection per season. I started in June.
Who buys today — people you know, or strangers?
Mostly strangers, at a makers' market once a month.
Understood. I am assigning finance, growth and product: your problem is not making them, it is selling without the stall.

pillars.title: What holds up once the novelty wears off

cards.title: It runs without you
cards.body: The team convenes overnight when an action stalls. You trigger nothing, you read the debrief when you wake up.

cards.title: One memory per project
cards.body: Decisions, risks, assumptions, milestones. Nothing is lost between sessions, and nothing bleeds between projects.

cards.title: French and English
cards.body: Mendly works in your language. Not a translation: two voices written separately.

app.emptyProjectsBody: A project keeps its own memory: decisions, risks, assumptions. Start by describing one.
